title: SettingsLayout
description: The settings window (D957 v4 section 10, A1737): its tabs from top to bottom on the left and the rows of each, by the setting's id (text key ui.settings.<id>, description ui.settings.<id>.desc). A tab without rows says that its settings come later. Limits and defaults stay with the settings themselves (ui tokens, player settings).

SettingsTab.description: A tab (text key ui.settings.tab.<id>) and its rows in their order.
